title: FastestVPN Pro protects 15 devices for life, now $30
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: FastestVPN Pro protects up to 15 devices with a lifetime VPN subscription, now on sale for $29.97 (MSRP $600).

Most VPN subscriptions run $10 to $15 a month, and that cost never stops. FastestVPN Pro replaces the monthly drain with a single lifetime purchase, and a lifetime subscription protects up to 15 devices at once.

FastestVPN Pro doesn’t limit your bandwidth or streaming options, with 900+ servers across 100+ countries. 256-bit encryption and double VPN protection keep you secure, routing traffic through two separate servers.

A NAT firewall, ad blocker, anti-malware, and split tunneling are all included without add-ons. P2P-optimized servers keep download speeds high, and dedicated streaming servers give you reliable access to Netflix, Disney+, Hulu, BBC iPlayer, and Amazon Prime.

FastestVPN Pro runs natively on Mac, iOS, and Apple TV alongside Windows, Android, and a long list of other platforms.

Your purchase also includes a free one-year Passhulk Password Manager subscription to store passwords, bank details, and credit card information in a single encrypted vault.

Drop the monthly VPN bill and protect every device you own under one price.

Get FastestVPN Pro on sale for $29.97 through September 10 at 11:59 p.m. PT (reg. $600). No coupon is needed.
